notes.title: Patch Notes - 8/9/22
notes.content:
Thanks for all the new players checking out the game recently! We've added some fixes and improvements that should help with those using ultra-wide and other less common screen resolutions.

Features:
[list]
[*]Added resolution dialog to menu and in-game options
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed button placement for the intro scene on ultra wide screen monitors
[*]Minor visual fixes and adjustments
[/list]
